home.hero_subtitle: Bespoke handcrafted ceramics for palaces, luxury hotels and private collectors — Made to last generations.
home.brand_intro_p1: Nestled in Jingdezhen — the world-famous 'Porcelain Capital' where kaolin clay and imperial kilns have crafted porcelain since 1004 AD — LuxeCeramics carries forward a millennium of ceramic heritage. Every piece is shaped, hand-painted and high-fired at 1,300°C through 72 heritage steps, from raw kaolin to finished porcelain.
home.brand_intro_p2: From our 20,000㎡ heritage atelier in Jingdezhen to our Dubai design studio, we bring the soul of Chinese porcelain to palaces, five-star hotels and private collectors across the Middle East.
home.category_sub: Six carefully curated lines, available off-the-shelf or fully customized to your vision.
home.case_sub: Selected installations from our hotel, villa and commercial collaborations.
home.client_sub: Proud partners of the world's most discerning hospitality groups and developers.
home.bottom_sub: Tell us about your project. Our team will reach out within 24 hours with a tailored proposal and WhatsApp follow-up.

about.title: About LuxeCeramics
about.story_p1: LuxeCeramics was born in Jingdezhen, Jiangxi — China's 1,000-year-old Porcelain Capital. For centuries this ancient city supplied imperial porcelain to the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing courts; today, it is where our master artisans — descendants of those same kiln traditions — select the finest kaolin clay from Gaoling Hill and hand-throw every vase, platter and tableware piece on the wheel.
about.story_p2: Our heritage atelier now spans 20,000㎡, housing 180 master throwers, blue-and-white painters and glaze chemists, an in-house R&D glaze lab, and a Dubai-based design studio that delivers bespoke porcelain to royal families, five-star hotels and private residences across the GCC.
about.story_p3: Our philosophy is carved into every piece: kaolin from the hills of Gaoling, 72 pairs of hands, and a 1,300°C kiln fire that has burned for a thousand years. A porcelain masterpiece is never rushed — it is awaited.
about.f_cap1_desc: Master throwers shape each piece on the wheel
about.f_cap2_desc: Exclusive matte gold, celadon and cobalt blue recipes
about.f_cap4_desc: Every piece checked against 36 quality points
about.cert_sub: Fully certified for hospitality and international export.
about.h_1995: Atelier founded in the heart of Jingdezhen's old imperial kiln district
about.h_2008: First royal commission — bespoke porcelain service for a UAE palace
about.h_2015: Heritage atelier expanded to 20,000㎡; celadon & gold glaze R&D lab opened
about.h_2019: Dubai showroom and design studio opened in D3, serving GCC clients directly
about.h_2024: 500+ luxury hospitality and royal residential projects delivered across GCC + Europe
